name: Orazca
description: Orazca is the legendary Golden City of Ixalan, hidden in the jungle and home of the Immortal Sun.

summary.text: Orazca is the legendary Golden City of Ixalan, hidden in the jungle and home of the Immortal Sun.

bio.text: Huatli glimpsed it when her spark ignited, and the emperor promised her the title of warrior-poet if she found it.
Vraska was tasked with retrieving an item from it, and its location was sworn secret by the River Heralds.
As several parties raced toward it, Orazca rose from the jungle and opened like a flower in gold, turquoise, amber and jade.
Kumena raised the city from the ground, opening a canyon around it and flooding it with rivers, after Azor had sealed himself in it and charged the River Heralds to guard it.
Huatli summoned an elder dinosaur through the city's power, and Apatzec later sent knights to clear it and found it empty before entering at the head of a procession.
During the Phyrexian assault, Orazca burned while Huatli waited atop the Winged Temple.

status.text: The last event in the material shows Orazca burning in the Phyrexian assault while Huatli waits atop the Winged Temple.

timeline.summary: Huatli's planeswalker spark ignites; she glimpses a golden city before being pulled back, with the planeswalker sigil appearing above her.
timeline.quote: It was a city that shone with the warmth of gold.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Inti she believes she saw Orazca.
timeline.quote: I think I saw Orazca.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Emperor Apatzec what she saw, and he declares it proof of her worthiness.
timeline.quote: What you saw is proof of your worthiness to hold that mantle.

timeline.summary: The emperor promises Huatli the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, and she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The title of warrior-poet is yours if you can locate the Golden City of Orazca.

timeline.summary: Inti offers to accompany Huatli with Teyeuh, and Huatli admits she wants to find the city.
timeline.quote: I want to find the city.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

timeline.summary: Kopala meditates in the Primal Wellspring with Tishana and feels the pulse of Orazca skip a beat.
timeline.quote: The pulse skips a beat.

timeline.summary: Tishana tells Kopala the disturbance involves Orazca.
timeline.quote: And what involves Orazca involves the whole world,

timeline.summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
timeline.quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
timeline.quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

timeline.summary: Jace theorizes the compass points to a specific kind of magical expression and that Orazca must be a massive hub of such energy.
timeline.quote: the Golden City would have to be a massive hub of magical energy

timeline.summary: Angrath says he will not harm Huatli, and proposes they escape together by finding the city.
timeline.quote: Whatever prevents us from leaving this plane is locked in that city.

timeline.summary: Angrath adds that they must kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca.
timeline.quote: And all we have to do is kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca from our grasp.

timeline.summary: The crew sees the spires of Orazca.
timeline.quote: Shining as golden beacons above the green, the spires of Orazca pierced the sky.

timeline.summary: An earthquake shakes the clearing and Orazca begins rising from the jungle.
timeline.quote: The city itself was emerging from the jungle with every jostle of the earthquake.

timeline.summary: Malcolm says someone must have arrived at the city first, and a great beast bellows.
timeline.quote: Someone must have arrived at the city first.

timeline.summary: The city opens like a flower in gold, turquoise, amber and jade.
timeline.quote: The city itself had opened like the petals of a flower.

timeline.summary: Jace loses his grip on a boulder and tumbles down the waterfall as Vraska reaches for him.
timeline.quote: the ground jerked sideways once more, and Jace lost his grip.

timeline.summary: Vraska falls after Jace and is swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.
timeline.quote: Vraska was swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.

timeline.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
timeline.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace is regaining all his memories and fears their friendship will dissolve.
timeline.quote: He would remember he was the Guildpact and she was an assassin and their friendship would certainly dissolve.

timeline.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
timeline.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Kumena climbs the great staircase and enters Orazca.
timeline.quote: Kumena ascended to the golden city at last.

timeline.summary: A voice from the golden walls calls Kumena to set it free.
timeline.quote: Kumena the Shaper, child of the Great River, leader of your people. Come set me free.

timeline.summary: Kumena realizes the voice is his own reflected power.
timeline.quote: The voice was deep and commanding, the voice of a leader. It was his own.

timeline.summary: The voice calls itself the Sun and tells Kumena to follow it through the labyrinth.
timeline.quote: I am the Sun, Kumena. As you will be.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the central tower and finds the Immortal Sun embedded in the floor.
timeline.quote: He stepped into the chamber, and beheld the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Kumena steps onto the Immortal Sun and takes its power.
timeline.quote: Kumena stepped onto the Immortal Sun and took that power, his power.

timeline.summary: Kumena raises the city from the ground, opening a canyon around it and flooding it with rivers.
timeline.quote: He flexed his fingers, and the city lurched upward, separating from the rock around it.

timeline.summary: Kumena's laughter is cut short when Vona confronts him atop the Sun.
timeline.quote: Kumena turned his physical form, the one that stood atop the Immortal Sun, and locked eyes with a vampire.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein tackle Kumena and wound him.
timeline.quote: The vampires scratched and bit, and one of their swords sliced a long line into Kumena's side.

timeline.summary: Vona throws Kumena out of the tower window.
timeline.quote: before Kumena could react, she threw him out the window.

timeline.summary: Jace lies bleeding on the riverbank, his mind broadcasting memories.
timeline.quote: Jace lay in agony on the riverbank.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace's injury has left his mind unable to contain his memories.
timeline.quote: He broadcasted his memories now in bursts and stops, clearly trying to wrestle them back under control.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds the weeping Jace, the first time she has touched anyone willingly in years.
timeline.quote: Vraska instantly dove to the ground and scooped him into her arms.

timeline.summary: Jace says Vraska saw everything and acknowledges she is an assassin; she answers she is also a friend.
timeline.quote: You're an assassin

timeline.summary: Jace says his memory is not fully back and has gaps.
timeline.quote: It's not all back. There are gaps.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

timeline.summary: Jace forgives Vraska for trying to kill him.
timeline.quote: I forgive you for trying to kill me,

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass, which points straight at the central tower.
timeline.quote: its light pointed an arrow-straight line toward the tower.

timeline.summary: Jace says the last three months were the best of his life.
timeline.quote: It was the best three months of my life.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace the person who listened to her is who he really is.
timeline.quote: That Jace is still in you, and I think that Jace is who you really are.

timeline.summary: Jace speaks of his mother wanting him to be a scholar.
timeline.quote: My mother wanted me to move to the city to be a scholar.

timeline.summary: Vraska helps Jace up and they start to climb the staircase to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Vraska held out a hand to help Jace to his feet.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he used to be a coward as they climb.
timeline.quote: I used to be a coward.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath watch Orazca rise from the valley.
timeline.quote: They watched as the golden spires of Orazca climbed higher and higher above the canopy of the valley below.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the real city unlike the one in her vision.
timeline.quote: The city was more beautiful than she could possibly have imagined . . . and it looked nothing like the city she had seen in her vision.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda says Orazca has awoken at last.
timeline.quote: Orazca has awoken at last.

timeline.summary: Huatli resolves to beat Angrath to Orazca.
timeline.quote: was going to get there before she did.

timeline.summary: Jace climbs the golden stairs to Orazca, exhausted and in control of his memories.
timeline.quote: He deliberately placed each foot ahead of the other as he ascended the stairs to Orazca

timeline.summary: Jace recalls trying to break into a golden dragon's mind and his own being erased (memory).
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into a dragon's mind.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Ugin bidding him farewell (memory).
timeline.quote: Good fortune, Jace Beleren

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass at the top of the stairs.
timeline.quote: What we need is in there.

timeline.summary: A huge flying creature rises over Orazca while Jace hides them with an illusion.
timeline.quote: An immense dinosaur's head towered over the city.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes his earnest self on Ixalan is who he always was.
timeline.quote: That was who he had always been. He had just forgotten.

timeline.summary: Jace remembers his mother and hopes she is alive.
timeline.quote: He liked being able to remember his mother.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Vraska he recalls the skills his mentor taught him.
timeline.quote: I can remember the skills my mentor taught me, now.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that Liliana never called him incredible, unlike Vraska.
timeline.quote: Liliana never told Jace he was incredible.

timeline.summary: Jace solves the maze on the tower's back door.
timeline.quote: Jace started to trace the solution to the maze, a line of blue magically trailing his fingers as they moved.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the door bears the Azorius symbol that appears when they try to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: It's the symbol of the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Jace senses a sphinx's mind inside the room.
timeline.quote: This person's mind was familiar, labyrinthine, a mind like only one he had ever encountered before.

timeline.summary: Vraska promises telepathically that no sphinx will hurt Jace again.
timeline.quote: You'll never be hurt by a sphinx ever again,

timeline.summary: The sphinx in the throne room announces himself as Azor and threatens Vraska.
timeline.quote: I am Azor, the Lawbringer,

timeline.summary: Jace shields Vraska's mind from Azor.
timeline.quote: Jace slammed a psychic ward between the sphinx and Vraska.

timeline.summary: Jace declares himself the Living Guildpact and Azor recoils, calling him the fail-safe.
timeline.quote: I am Jace Beleren, the Living Guildpact,

timeline.summary: Huatli and Tishana enter Orazca and see a dark storm rising from its tower.
timeline.quote: after some time, Huatli blinked sweat from her eyes as she passed through the gate of the golden city.

timeline.summary: Kumena falls from the tower and Tishana's wind breaks his fall.
timeline.quote: The body's descent slowed and then stopped altogether as a massive gust of wind rose up to break the fall

timeline.summary: Huatli concludes the Legion of Dusk has taken control of the Immortal Sun and the city.
timeline.quote: the Legion of Dusk had taken control of the Immortal Sun

timeline.summary: Tishana proposes they take the vampires together and resolve ownership afterward.
timeline.quote: We can take them together,

timeline.summary: Breeches charges the tower shouting for the Sun while Malcolm flies above.
timeline.quote: WE WANT SUN! WE WANT SUN!

timeline.summary: Huatli and Tishana burst into the Sun chamber and Vona claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: I am Vona, Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun belongs to the Legion of Dusk!

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes the Immortal Sun is a disk set into the floor.
timeline.quote: the disk could only be the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Tishana's elemental slams into Vona while Huatli takes on the hierophant.
timeline.quote: Her elemental had grown large once more and barreled into Vona's side as she stood on the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Vona uses the Immortal Sun to turn Huatli's blood against her.
timeline.quote: Vona was using the Immortal Sun to manipulate her blood.

timeline.summary: Malcolm's song enthralls everyone in the chamber until Breeches leaps onto Vona's face.
timeline.quote: The goblin leaped forward onto Vona's face.

timeline.summary: Angrath breaks down the doors, having burned through the dinosaur Huatli left on him.
timeline.quote: The golden doors to the room were lying flat on the ground, and standing above them, howling in rage, was Angrath.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Tishana, Angrath and Vona all touch the Immortal Sun and a surge of energy passes through them.
timeline.quote: The four of them gasped as an immense current of energy passed through them.

timeline.summary: Through the Sun, Huatli senses the Elder Dinosaurs awaken and calls them to her.
timeline.quote: She called Elder Dinosaurs to her, and felt the ground tremble as they began to approach.

timeline.summary: Huatli senses Emperor Apatzec's army at the city's edge, realizing she was not sent alone.
timeline.quote: she felt the footsteps of Emperor Apatzec's army.

timeline.summary: Breeches and Malcolm hear Jace and the floor gives way beneath the standoff.
timeline.quote: Malcolm, you heard Jace too?!

timeline.summary: Azor greets Vraska and Jace from his throne, asking who they have brought to seal.
timeline.quote: If this gorgon is not my prisoner, then who have you brought for me to seal?

timeline.summary: Azor calls the Immortal Sun the lock of his prison and Vraska realizes it is what traps planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The lock of my prison, my finest creation.

timeline.summary: Azor binds Vraska with law magic through Jace's ward, but Jace frees her.
timeline.quote: A binding of glowing white runic magic grabbed hold of her torso and shoved her back toward the door behind them.

timeline.summary: Azor boasts of imposing stability on worlds for thousands of years.
timeline.quote: I used hieromancy to give these people the gift of stability

timeline.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers and that he gave up his spark to make it.
timeline.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

timeline.summary: Azor explains the failed plan with a friend to lure a foe to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: He was to lure our foe to a faraway plane and I was to use the Immortal Sun to enhance my hieromancy and summon that foe here, to Ixalan.

timeline.summary: Azor explains he gave the Immortal Sun to a monastery in Torrezon and then to others who proved unworthy.
timeline.quote: I initially gifted it to a monastery in the east, in Torrezon.

timeline.summary: Azor attacks Vraska and Jace; Vraska cuts his leg.
timeline.quote: Vraska unsheathed her sword and cut a long thin line across Azor's back leg.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks Azor's mind with a migraine.
timeline.quote: manipulate Azor's mind, sending the feeling of a piercing migraine through the sphinx's head.

timeline.summary: Vraska accuses Azor of causing centuries of war and her own suffering.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun has spawned hundreds of years of conflict on this plane,

timeline.summary: Jace takes responsibility to judge Azor as Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: It is my responsibility to act on behalf of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the plan was to imprison Nicol Bolas, and Jace remembers him.
timeline.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

timeline.summary: Jace sentences Azor to be the caretaker of Useless Island, never to leave or meddle again.
timeline.quote: You will be the master and caretaker of Useless Island.

timeline.summary: Azor flies away, leaving the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: He beat them, rose into the air, and flew out the door Vraska and Jace had entered through without another word.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks why Bolas wants a planeswalker prison and Jace says she needs to know who she works for.
timeline.quote: you need to know who you're working for.

timeline.summary: Azor seals himself in Orazca and charges the River Heralds to guard it.
timeline.quote: this time sealing himself within the walls of Orazca and charging the River Heralds

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska share everything they know about Bolas.
timeline.quote: Jace told Vraska everything he knew about Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Vraska is meant to call Tezzeret to retrieve the Immortal Sun through the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: It's Tezzeret. He's the one you're meant to call.

timeline.summary: They deduce Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals and the Sun would trap anyone who arrives.
timeline.quote: He made an army he could transport across the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Bolas wants her help to unleash an army on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: He wants to unleash an army.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks Jace to take and hide her memories of him so Bolas will not see them.
timeline.quote: I need you to temporarily take my memories of you.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes the plan is to betray Bolas.
timeline.quote: You want to betray Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Vraska lays out the plan to accept Bolas's offer of guild leader and wait until Jace restores her memories.
timeline.quote: He promised me the title of guild leader.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Oubevir's Maneuver can hide the gap in Vraska's memories.
timeline.quote: It's a way to smooth over evidence of mental tampering.

timeline.summary: They choose Niv-Mizzet as the one to help devise the plan.
timeline.quote: He could challenge Nicol Bolas both physically and mentally

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska swear oaths to keep her memories safe and to sabotage Bolas when they are returned.
timeline.quote: I swear to commit my conscious self to his destruction.

timeline.summary: Jace says he must meet his friends on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: I need to meet my friends on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Jace sends Vraska's message to her crew, leaving Amelia in charge.
timeline.quote: Tell them to return to the ship, Amelia's in charge

timeline.summary: Jace promises to call Vraska Captain before restoring her memories.
timeline.quote: I'll call you Captain.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to a date at Tin Street Market and he accepts.
timeline.quote: It's a date.

timeline.summary: Jace seals Vraska's memories of him in a warded box hidden in her mind.
timeline.quote: She saw her memories of Jace tied up in a bundle, placed within a box, sealed with an unbreakable ward.

timeline.summary: Vraska wakes without her memories of Jace in the empty throne room.
timeline.quote: How did I get here?

timeline.summary: Vraska casts the spell that opens a violet portal beneath the Immortal Sun, which is pulled to another plane.
timeline.quote: when a violet circle opened up directly beneath the Immortal Sun

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is pulled away and Vraska planeswalks off Ixalan.
timeline.quote: As the portal closed, Vraska planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes and Huatli, Tishana, Vona and Angrath fall into the room below.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun vanished beneath their feet

timeline.summary: Angrath curses the plane and planeswalks away, free at last.
timeline.quote: SEE YOU NEVER, PATHETIC FOOLS!

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes both the Immortal Sun and the barrier are gone.
timeline.quote: Both the Immortal Sun and the barrier.

timeline.summary: Vona cries out that the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is gone!

timeline.summary: Breeches and Malcolm decide to run away.
timeline.quote: RUNNING AWAY!

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda arrives and asks whether the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: Is it gone, children of night?

timeline.summary: Elenda accepts the Sun is gone for good and tells her followers they are free.
timeline.quote: No, my child. We are free. It is gone forever.

timeline.summary: Elenda reveals she ended her journey centuries ago upon finding Orazca.
timeline.quote: My journey ended centuries ago, when I found this place.

timeline.summary: Elenda explains her order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not use it, and that she sealed herself away here.
timeline.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

timeline.summary: Vona says they conquered Torrezon and built an empire in Elenda's honor.
timeline.quote: We conquered Torrezon,

timeline.summary: Huatli urges Elenda to return home and tell her own story.
timeline.quote: You must be the one to tell your story. Not them.

timeline.summary: Elenda demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.
timeline.quote: Take me to Queen Miralda,

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein slices Vona's cheek for insulting Elenda.
timeline.quote: Do not speak ill of a living saint!

timeline.summary: Elenda forces Vona to the floor with a magical command.
timeline.quote: Elenda snapped her fingers angrily and Vona's knees buckled

timeline.summary: The three vampires leave into the night.
timeline.quote: the three vampires exited into the night.

timeline.summary: Tishana declares Orazca found and Ixalan at peace.
timeline.quote: Orazca is found

timeline.summary: Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.
timeline.quote: Orazca belongs to no one,

timeline.summary: Tishana agrees the River Heralds are open to negotiation.
timeline.quote: Yes. The River Heralds are.

timeline.summary: Huatli summons an elder dinosaur through the city's power.
timeline.quote: The threefold roar of an elder dinosaur filled her ears, and Huatli smiled.

timeline.summary: Vraska's memory shows a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, which Bolas accepts as true.
timeline.quote: watching as a sphinx rampaged through Orazca . . .

timeline.summary: Jace stays invisible as the Sun vanishes and the others leave.
timeline.quote: Jace had shrouded himself in invisibility as the Immortal Sun vanished

timeline.summary: Jace sends Malcolm a farewell message for the crew.
timeline.quote: Captain is safe, but far away

timeline.summary: Jace thinks of the promised coffee and book with Vraska.
timeline.quote: His mind drifted to the promise of coffee and a book.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves that Ravnica must come first.
timeline.quote: Ravnica must come first.

timeline.summary: Jace chooses to track Gideon rather than Liliana to reach Dominaria.
timeline.quote: What he felt for her now wasn't anything resembling affection.

timeline.summary: Apatzec sends knights to clear Orazca and finds it empty.
timeline.quote: He had immediately sent a battalion of his strongest knights to clear the city

timeline.summary: Apatzec enters Orazca at the head of a procession.
timeline.quote: The trees gave way to pillars of endless gold as they entered the city.

timeline.summary: Apatzec declares Orazca the Sun Empire's again and names Torrezon as next.
timeline.quote: Ixalan is ours . . . and Torrezon is next.

timeline.summary: Tishana is left alone in Orazca after Huatli departs (non-canon River Heralds ending).
timeline.quote: Tishana watched as Huatli departed on the back of the elder dinosaur.

timeline.summary: Tishana distrusts the Sun Empire under Emperor Apatzec III.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was still ruled by Emperor Apatzec III, after all.

timeline.summary: Tishana commands the elementals to guard every entrance against non-merfolk forces.
timeline.quote: Tishana willed them to stand guard, to be ready for any non-merfolk force that may try to enter Orazca.

timeline.summary: Tishana resolves to settle the River Heralds permanently and rename the city the City of Golden Water.
timeline.quote: The River Heralds would settle here permanently

timeline.summary: Vona refuses to return to Torrezon empty-handed (non-canon Legion of Dusk ending).
timeline.quote: I will not return to Torrezon empty-handed,

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda tells Vona to claim Orazca and sails east.
timeline.quote: Claim Orazca for your own. I will sail to the East.

timeline.summary: Vona returns and claims Orazca for the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: Orazca had been claimed for the Legion of Dusk!

timeline.summary: A giant dinosaur eats Vona in the plaza.
timeline.quote: Vona did not have time to scream as the dinosaur snapped her up into its jaws.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches, told by Jace to let Vraska go, find Orazca empty (non-canon pirate ending).
timeline.quote: Captain's orders are to let her go, Breeches.

timeline.summary: Breeches notes everyone else has left Orazca.
timeline.quote: Orazca empty,

timeline.summary: A week later the Belligerent's crew carouses in Azor's old sanctum on looted gold, with Malcolm and Breeches as co-emperors.
timeline.quote: Will you join me for ale and cards, Co-Emperor Breeches?

timeline.summary: Huatli waits atop the Winged Temple while Orazca burns and Ixalan is wreathed in fire.
timeline.quote: Huatli, alone, stood atop the Winged Temple of Orazca

timeline.summary: Hours before, Huatli's company and the auxiliaries shelter in a barricaded hall, and Inti urges them to go.
timeline.quote: I'm not confident the barricade or this hall will hold.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Mavren the trap was part of her plan, since bait is necessary when hunting a great beast.
timeline.quote: Bait is necessary.

timeline.summary: At Orazca, scouts report a route to the temple and Temilo, a garrisoned soldier, joins them.
timeline.quote: We have a route to the temple.

timeline.summary: Etali, an elder dinosaur turned by Phyrexia, appears on the horizon with a roar and a storm.
timeline.quote: On the horizon opposite them, at the lip of the bowl in which Orazca was built, stood Etali, one of the elder dinosaurs.

timeline.summary: Huatli sees that nothing of Ixalan is left in Etali and flees with the company to Temilo's garrison.
timeline.quote: Etali was the storm. The Phyrexians had turned the elder dinosaur

timeline.summary: Huatli rejects the idea of being mere survivors and resolves to fight to the top of the Winged Temple to call the elders.
timeline.quote: Then we will fight to the top and call upon the elders.

timeline.summary: Tetzimoc, Ghalta and Nezahal answer Huatli's call and tear through the Phyrexians in the streets.
timeline.quote: Nezahal wrapped the giant up from legs to wrists

timeline.summary: Zacama acknowledges Huatli before departing, and the sun breaks through over Orazca.
timeline.quote: Dawn had arrived: the day, though not yet won, was here.

timeline.summary: Wayta leads Quint to a view of the golden city of Orazca.
timeline.quote: saw the full, blinding brilliance of the golden city in the valley below

timeline.summary: Quint meets Saheeli and Huatli in a chamber of tablets and a huge golden door.
timeline.quote: This is my partner, Huatli.

timeline.summary: Huatli explains that the translated glyphs suggest the door leads to the birthplace of humanity and home of the gods.
timeline.quote: I believe they're the key to opening this.

timeline.summary: Inti arrives and is introduced as Huatli's cousin and a hero of the war against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Seneschal of the sun, dinosaur rider, hero of the war against the Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: Inti relays that the emperor is growing impatient and wants the door opened by other means; Huatli asks for more time.
timeline.quote: The emperor grows more impatient

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals the emperor is keenly interested in her fire-breathing constructs, and Huatli confesses she fears more war.
timeline.quote: I made the mistake of wondering aloud if I could make them breathe fire.

timeline.summary: Huatli finishes translating the tablets' poem about the Komon and the imprisoned god Chimil.
timeline.quote: The translation was finished.

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes the door's glyphs match the tablets symbolically and slots them in correctly; the golden door cracks open.
timeline.quote: A whisper of magic touched her fingers, and the space around each tablet glowed softly.

timeline.summary: Beyond the door, Huatli's party finds glowing, linen-wrapped warrior corpses and the armored remains of a massive horned creature.
timeline.quote: The remains of a massive humanoid creature dominated the opposite corner of the room

timeline.summary: Huatli orders word sent to Inti and Caparocti that the expedition leaves as soon as the pack dinosaurs are ready.
timeline.quote: Tell them we leave as soon as the pack dinosaurs are ready.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Saheeli the way is open and they will part soon.
timeline.quote: I need to take my fill of you before we part.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Saheeli attend the boy-emperor's court at Orazca during his post-invasion tour.
timeline.quote: The boy-emperor, Apatzec Intli IV, had traveled here with a great retinue as part of his post-invasion, post-coronation tour of the lands under his dominion.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reviews the background: the previous emperor was killed by a Phyrexian assassin and his young son took the throne.
timeline.quote: the previous emperor had not planned to die at the hands of a Phyrexian assassin

timeline.summary: The court's factions are laid out, with Atlacan opposed by Caztaca for control of the boy-emperor.
timeline.quote: Opposing Atlacan was Caztaca Huicintli, the apex priest of the Threefold Sun and eldest daughter of the late emperor.

timeline.summary: Saheeli explains she produces about a dozen filigree quetzacama a day and describes the talent bottleneck.
timeline.quote: We produce around a dozen of my filigree quetzacama daily

timeline.summary: Saheeli announces a six to eight month delay in the order.
timeline.quote: I anticipate a delay of six to eight months.

timeline.summary: Atlacan threatens consequences if the mechanoquetzacama are not delivered on time.
timeline.quote: You will have the emperor's mechanoquetzacama complete in the time first promised, or there will be consequences

timeline.summary: Atlacan orders Huatli to explore newly found chambers below Orazca with Caparocti's lancers.
timeline.quote: you will accompany Caparocti Sunborn and his lancers on this journey and serve as the eyes of the empire.

timeline.summary: In the market Huatli tells Saheeli that Atlacan wants to resume his father's war on Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Atlacan wants to resume his father's war

timeline.summary: Huatli says Atlacan is already building a second Dawn Fleet at Queen's Bay.
timeline.quote: He is already building a second Dawn Fleet in Queen's Bay, larger and mightier than the first.

timeline.summary: Huatli explains that without her spark she cannot resist openly.
timeline.quote: Without my spark I cannot escape the consequences of resistance.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she requested aid through an Omenpath, and that a planeswalker student named Quintorius Kand is coming.
timeline.quote: The last Omenpath that appeared opened only to Arcavios; I immediately sent a request for aid, and they said they would send a student of history.

timeline.summary: Huatli reveals a planned coup to depose Atlacan and place Caztaca beside the emperor.
timeline.quote: The meeting is to plan how to depose Atlacan, defang the emperor's guard, and move Caztaca to power at the emperor's side.

timeline.summary: Huatli asks Saheeli to speak with her voice at the meeting and introduces Chitlati.
timeline.quote: At this meeting, you speak with my voice.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun passes from legend to reality and all the peoples of Ixalan seek its power.
timeline.quote: now legend has become reality, and all the peoples of Ixalan seek the Immortal Sun and the power it promises.

timeline.summary: As the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples search desperately for the golden city.
timeline.quote: And as the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples are catapulted into a desperate search for the golden city and the treasure it holds.

relations.quote: Secure in the ancient golden city of Orazca, the Immortal Sun is an artifact of mythic power

The Golden City that the compass points to, thought to hold the Immortal Sun.
The Golden City, which rises from the jungle like a flower and is believed to hold the Immortal Sun and the barrier keeping planeswalkers on Ixalan.
The golden city containing the Immortal Sun that rises from the jungle.
The golden city that rises from the jungle, containing the Immortal Sun.
The awakened golden city with the Immortal Sun in its central tower.
The city in which Azor sealed himself with the Immortal Sun.
The unbound golden city, built with Sun Empire magic.
The golden city claimed by Apatzec.
The golden city claimed in each alternate ending.
A golden city of Ixalan that burns during the Phyrexian assault.
A golden city with a central temple-pyramid, battered by war, where Huatli and Saheeli work on the tablets.
The golden city where the Sun Empire and River Heralds had tense relations before the war.
The golden city taken from the River Heralds.
The golden city.
The golden city where the emperor holds court and where new chambers have been found below.
The ancient golden city in Ixalan's jungle where the Immortal Sun lies secure.
